gates.scope: Finite CPU/GPU mode 4, mode 5, Euclidean primitives and simple closed vector paths; not general topology or native fidelity.
Finite density/magnification and rebased edge controls.

Mathematical box integration and native-derived 13-tap continuous reconstruction verified on CPU/GPU; separate exact finite native mip preparation at fixed logical pitch. Not a universal native LOD or renderer claim.

gates.reason: All 16 current authored round-stroke icon assets ingest and run on GPU; 36,864 browser membership comparisons and 576 GPU controls retained as finite diagnostics. Independent direct stroke union supports 105/106 outline/browser disagreement points in favor of the outline, one in favor of original browser at 1x. Exact general stroke/boolean tolerances, robust singular normals, arbitrary SVG styles/transforms, portability and exact browser glyph shaping remain open.

Live Clear and Regular variable-blur compute dispatches and complete mip textures recovered; independent mathematical replay matches all 11 textures across four captured native cases. Exact 13-tap weights and finite copy/downsample arithmetic validated. Unrestricted public scale/radius, crop, source capture, level and branch selection still open (LG-P-SCALARS).

15,992 exact mathematical channel outputs on independent native copy/even-mip cases; 4,136 further exact odd-mip outputs using measured hardware samples plus independent arithmetic. Portable odd-size sampler internals and full native program equivalence still open (LG-SR-NATIVE).
LG-Q-NUMERICAL remains open; runtime color and EDR chain not established.
Actual dynamic hover, click and release operator not recovered; existing browser-authored response remains a candidate.

Four native Clear/Regular intermediate-resource chains now reproduced mathematically byte-for-byte with captured input and ABI. Offscreen output stripe classes retained. Equivalent final fragment/material and active-display output lineage is not established.

Fixed-source GPU prefix integration passes finite CPU comparisons and accelerates a 128-query large-footprint benchmark; memory overhead, large artwork binding budgets, full-frame performance, 16 moving surfaces, overlap, scroll/route transitions and production regression validation remain open.

latestResearchValidation.scope: Finite native compute and browser/CPU/GPU diagnostics; not full Apple Glass equivalence.
